name: Shintō (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Shintō village emblem in white: a disc with a stylised bird-like crest at the upper fly.
history: Municipal flag of Shintō, a village in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 1973.

features.role: Shintō village emblem — a disc with a stylised bird-like crest at the upper fly
